description: What to put in the project: every included sound's event key and the take in use (file link valid 15 minutes, SHA-256), the sounds not ready yet, and zip_url for one ZIP (download it with the same Authorization header) holding the files in the chosen format, sounds.json (event key → file) and a README. Wire the game's events to sounds.json and let the user check the sounds in the game.

format.description: File type in the ZIP (default wav).
